Setup, presets and a reference for every section of the theme.
Upload the theme and open the editor.

The theme is built for Online Store 2.0 with native vanilla JavaScript, so there is no framework to install and nothing to configure before the first preview.

  1. Download the theme zip file from your Shopify account or your Theme Store purchase.
  2. In the Shopify admin, go to Online store > Themes.
  3. Under Theme library, choose Add theme > Upload zip file.
  4. Select the zip file and upload it.
  5. Choose Customize to open the theme editor.
Three starting points for different houses.
Each preset changes theme settings only, so switching does not move or delete the content of your sections.
Warm editorial elegance for tailoring and bespoke fashion. Alabaster grounds, rich contrast and a serif voice.
Crisp architectural minimalism. High contrast type, sharp rules and gallery whitespace for contemporary fashion and accessories.
Heritage warmth with deeper tones and dramatic composition, for vintage curation, leather goods, watches and legacy houses.
To change preset, open Theme settings and pick one from the preset list at the top of the panel.
Where the palette and the type scale live.

Colour schemes are configured in Theme settings > Colours, and every section can carry its own scheme. Body and heading fonts, scale and weight live in Theme settings > Typography, with system fallbacks handled for you.

The shipped schemes hold the contrast ratios that accessibility review asks for: 4.5:1 for text and 3:1 for interface boundaries. If you change the colours, keep that in mind.
The pieces that carry the storefront.

• Hero editorial: full viewport and split banners with separate desktop and mobile images, focal point control and alignment settings.
  • Complete the look: shoppable bundles that add several products to the cart at once, each with its own variant picker.
  • Lookbook: hotspots over a photograph that open product cards with live price and availability.
  • Curated showcase: tabbed collections with keyboard support.
  • Featured product: a standalone product with variant pickers, gallery and accelerated checkout.

• 3D models and augmented reality: upload .glb or .gltf files to the product media gallery and the viewer starts on supported devices.
  • Colour swatches: native Shopify category swatches, with either a colour or a swatch image.
  • Line total: the total for the chosen quantity is recalculated as the shopper changes it, without touching the unit price above.
  • Gift card recipient: name, email, message and send date for digital gift cards.
  • Pickup availability: live local stock and pickup times.
What the slide-out cart can do.

• Free shipping progress with a threshold you set.
  • Order notes, terms checkbox and discount display.
  • Accelerated checkout buttons.
  • Quantity steppers that keep the cart in step with the server even under fast repeated taps.

Search suggests products, collections, pages and articles as the shopper types, through Shopify’s own predictive search.

Collection and search pages carry faceted filters that read prices written with a comma decimal separator and announce every result change to screen readers.
Where to write when something is wrong.
Open a ticket from the support page of this store. Say which page you were on, what you expected and what happened, and include your store address.
Check that you are on the latest version of the theme before reporting an issue.
When will my order be dispatched?
Pieces held in the atelier leave within three business days. Made-to-order work carries its own dispatch estimate on the product page.
How do I follow my parcel?
A tracking link is sent as soon as the parcel leaves the studio. It can take a day before the carrier shows the first scan.
Every product page carries the measurements of the piece and of the model wearing it. Write to us with your usual size and we will tell you how this cut behaves.
Sleeve and hem adjustments are available on tailored pieces. Ask before ordering so the work is scheduled with the making.
How should I care for these fabrics?
Care instructions travel with each piece. As a rule, natural fibres prefer airing over washing and a cool iron over a hot one.

How do I switch between the Sartorial, Edition and Archive presets?
Open your theme in the editor, go to theme settings and choose a preset at the top of the panel. Presets change settings only, so your section content stays where it is.
How do 3D models and augmented reality work?
Upload your .glb or .gltf files to the product media gallery in the Shopify admin. The theme starts the Shopify XR viewer on supported devices without any extra setup.
How do I set up colour swatches for variants?
The theme reads native Shopify category swatches. Categorise the option as colour in the admin and define the colour or swatch image on the variant.

Every LINEA NOVE piece is finished and packed by hand in our atelier. This page explains how your order travels to you and how to return a piece that is not right.

Order processing

Pieces held in the atelier leave within three business days. Made-to-order work carries its own dispatch estimate on the product page. You receive a tracking link as soon as your parcel leaves the studio.

Shipping

Shipping is complimentary on orders over $150. Below that amount, the shipping rate for your address is shown at checkout before you pay. Delivery times depend on your destination and are estimated at checkout.

Returns

Returns are complimentary within fourteen days of delivery. Pieces must be unworn and returned with their original tags in place. Made-to-order work is final sale. Start a return by writing to us through the contact page with your order number.

Refunds

Once your return reaches the atelier and passes inspection, we refund the original payment method. Your bank may take a few business days to show the refund.

Exchanges

To change a size or colour, return the original piece and place a new order. This keeps the piece you want reserved while the return travels back to us.

Damaged or incorrect items

If a piece arrives damaged or is not what you ordered, contact us within seven days of delivery with a photograph and your order number. We cover the return and send a replacement or a full refund.
